description: Unofficial Ishmael fan-art companion in her LCB default appearance from Limbus Company. Original routines include a loose soft-cord knot, flattening a blank sea chart with foam weights, and feeling a breeze before tucking a hair lock. Long orange hair and layered shirt, tie and coat are retained; closed shoes are conservatively simplified. No weapon, hazardous rope use or readable navigation data appears.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
